ja: 空席があるよ。
en: There's an empty seat.
alternatives: One seat is free.
A seat is available.
point: an empty seat は空いている席。

ja: 追加の運賃がかかる。
en: There's an extra fare.
alternatives: An extra fare applies.
You pay an extra fare.
point: an extra fare は追加の運賃。

ja: 私がタクシーを呼ぶよ。
en: I'll call a taxi.
alternatives: I'm going to call a taxi.
I'll get us a taxi.
point: その場で決めた申し出は I'll 〜

ja: バスを待つのは嫌いです。
en: I hate waiting for buses.
alternatives: I hate waiting for the bus.
I can't stand waiting for buses.
point: hate の後は -ing。待つは wait for

ja: 私が疲れるのは、乗り換えの多さです。
en: It's all the transfers that wear me out.
alternatives: What wears me out is all the transfers.
The transfers are what wear me out.
point: It's と that で挟んで強調。wear out はへとへとにする

ja: 乗り換えが私には難関だ。
en: What stumps me is changing trains.
alternatives: Changing trains is what confuses me.
What confuses me is switching trains.
point: stump は困らせて分からなくさせる。

ja: 電車は遅れた上に、運休になった。
en: Not only was it late, it was canceled.
alternatives: The train was not only late but also canceled.
On top of being late, it was canceled.
point: Not only を前に出すと was が主語の前に来る

ja: 運転手は休んでいい？
en: Can the driver rest?
alternatives: May the driver rest?
Can the driver take a break?
point: Can はここでは休む許可を求める。

ja: 席にいてね。
en: Stay in your seat.
alternatives: Remain in your seat.
Don't leave your seat.
point: stay はその場所にとどまる。

ja: 切符を二枚ください。
en: Two tickets, please.
alternatives: Can I have two tickets?
I'd like two tickets, please.
point: 数字の後は複数形の tickets

ja: 乗車にはカードが必要です。
en: You need a card to board.
alternatives: You need a card to ride.
A card is needed to board.
You can't board without a card.
point: 目的の to do「〜するために」

ja: もう電車は出ていた。
en: The train had already left.
alternatives: The train had left already.
The train had already gone.
point: 到着より前に済んでいたことは過去完了

ja: 電車が十分も止まってる。
en: We've been stopped for ten minutes.
alternatives: We've been stuck here for ten minutes.
The train's been stopped for ten minutes.
point: 「〜分も」続いている状態は現在完了進行形

ja: 私はもうカードに入金した。
en: I've already topped up my card.
alternatives: I've already reloaded my card.
I've already recharged my transit card.
point: top up は残高を追加する。

ja: この時刻表は頼れない。
en: This timetable isn't reliable.
alternatives: You can't rely on this timetable.
This timetable isn't dependable.
point: reliable は当てにできる、信頼できる。

ja: 往復を一枚ください。
en: A round-trip ticket, please.
alternatives: One round-trip ticket, please.
I'd like a round-trip ticket.
point: 一枚は a か one。往復は round-trip

ja: 外を見ていれば、降りられたのに。
en: If I'd looked, I'd have gotten off.
alternatives: I'd have gotten off if I'd looked.
If I'd looked up, I'd have made my stop.
point: if + had + 過去分詞, would have + 過去分詞

ja: これは京都に行きますか？
en: Does this go to Kyoto?
alternatives: Does this train go to Kyoto?
Is this the train for Kyoto?
point: 行き先は go to、疑問は Does で始める

ja: 私たちはタクシーを避けるべき。
en: We should steer clear of taxis.
alternatives: We ought to avoid taxis.
We should keep away from taxis.
point: steer clear of は関わらないよう避ける。

ja: バスがいつ出るか、わかる？
en: Do you know when it leaves?
alternatives: Do you know when the bus leaves?
Can you tell me when it leaves?
point: 間接疑問は when のあとが平叙文の語順

ja: 電車に乗り遅れました。
en: I missed my train.
alternatives: I missed the train.
I couldn't catch my train.
point: 乗り遅れるは miss。過去形は missed

ja: あの運転手、いつ出発か知ってるかな。
en: I wonder if he knows when we're leaving.
alternatives: I wonder whether the driver knows when we leave.
I wonder if the driver knows when we're leaving.
point: wonder if の中に when 節が入る

ja: 駅はどこですか？
en: Where is the station?
alternatives: Which way is the station?
Which way to the station?
point: 場所は Where is 〜? で聞く

ja: 私なら、もう電車には見切りをつけるよ。
en: If I were you, I'd bail on the train.
alternatives: If I were you, I'd ditch the train.
If I were you, I'd give up on it.
If I were you, I'd cut my losses now.
point: 「見切りをつける」は bail on / give up on

ja: 私、彼女に乗り換えを頼んだ。
en: I asked her to change trains.
alternatives: I asked her to switch trains.
I requested she change trains.
point: ask 人 to do は行動を頼む。

ja: 駅員は、この電車は運休と言った。
en: The staff said this train was canceled.
alternatives: A staff member said this train was canceled.
The attendant told me this train had been canceled.
point: said の後は時制を一つ過去側にずらす

ja: 市内に行くバスはどこ？
en: Where's the bus that goes downtown?
alternatives: Where's the bus going downtown?
Where's the bus to downtown?
point: 「〜するバス」は the bus that + 動詞

ja: 昨日、電車が遅れました。
en: The train was late yesterday.
alternatives: The train ran late yesterday.
My train was delayed yesterday.
point: 「遅れた」は was late か ran late

ja: 私が迷ってたら今も鉄道路線を検討中だ。
en: Had I vacillated, I'd still be weighing rail routes.
alternatives: If I'd wavered, I'd still be considering rail routes.
I'd still be weighing rail routes had I hesitated.
point: 過去の仮定で今の迷いを表す、vacillate は決めかねる。

ja: 今必要なのは、タクシーです。
en: What I need now is a taxi.
alternatives: A taxi is what I need right now.
What I need right now is a cab.
point: What I need is に続けて「必要なのは〜」

ja: 遅いものの、バスのほうが安い。
en: Though slower, the bus is cheaper.
alternatives: Although it's slower, the bus is cheaper.
The bus is cheaper, although it's slower.
The bus is slower, but cheaper.
point: though は「〜だが」、but は不要

ja: 急行の方が速いですか？
en: Is the express faster?
alternatives: Is the express train quicker?
Does the express go faster?
point: 速い の比較級は faster。than は不要

ja: カードで払えますか？
en: Can I pay by card?
alternatives: Can I use a card?
Do you take cards?
point: 支払い手段は by card で言う

ja: 終バス逃してタクシーで帰った。
en: Having missed the last bus, I cabbed home.
alternatives: Missing the last bus, I took a cab.
After missing the last bus, I cabbed.
point: 先に起きたことは having done で表す

ja: 私の定期はもう失効した。
en: My pass has already lapsed.
alternatives: My pass has already expired.
My pass is no longer valid.
point: has lapsed は失効して今も使えない状態。

ja: バスが遅れたら、歩いて行きます。
en: If the bus is late, I'll walk.
alternatives: I'll walk if the bus is late.
If the bus runs late, I'll walk.
point: 未来のことでも if 節は現在形

ja: 奈良行きのバスは満席です。
en: The bus to Nara is full.
alternatives: The Nara bus is full.
The bus heading to Nara is full.
The bus bound for Nara is fully booked.
point: 名詞の後ろに前置詞句 to Nara を置く

ja: ここに座ってもかまいませんか？
en: Mind if I sit here?
alternatives: Do you mind if I sit here?
Is it okay if I sit here?
Would you mind if I sat here?
point: mind は「いい」なら No で答える

ja: バスはもう発車していた。
en: The bus had already pulled away.
alternatives: The bus had already departed.
The bus had already driven off.
point: had pulled away はその時より前に発車したこと。

ja: 切符はすぐ出せるように。
en: Keep your ticket handy.
alternatives: Have your ticket ready.
Keep your ticket within reach.
point: handy はすぐ使える場所にある。

ja: 私が信じた路線は一度も当てになってない。
en: Never has the route I trusted proved reliable.
alternatives: The route I trusted has never proved reliable.
The route I trusted has never been dependable.
point: never を先頭に出すと has が主語より前に出る。

ja: 電車が来ています。
en: The train is coming.
alternatives: Our train is coming.
The train's arriving now.
point: 今近づいている最中は進行形

ja: 電車を間違えたかもしれません。
en: I may have taken the wrong train.
alternatives: I might've gotten on the wrong train.
I think I got on the wrong train.
point: may have + 過去分詞で過去の推測をやわらげる

ja: 私が確認してれば立ち往生せず済んだ。
en: Had I checked, I wouldn't have been stranded.
alternatives: If I'd checked, I wouldn't have been stranded.
I wouldn't have been stranded if I'd checked.
point: had I で過去の反実仮想を倒置して表す。

ja: 駅を乗り過ごしたかも。
en: I might have missed my stop.
alternatives: I may have missed my stop.
I could have missed my stop.
I think I missed my stop.
point: 過去の可能性は might have done

ja: 終電に間に合えばよかった。
en: I wish I'd caught the last train.
alternatives: If only I'd caught the last train.
I wish I hadn't missed the last train.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + had + 過去分詞

ja: 点検のため、運転見合わせ中です。
en: Service is suspended pending an inspection.
alternatives: Service has been suspended for an inspection.
Service has been halted pending an inspection.
point: 「運転見合わせ」は service is suspended

ja: バスが動いてる。
en: The bus is moving.
alternatives: The bus is rolling.
The bus is traveling.
point: 進行形でバスが今動いていると伝える。

ja: 運転手に待ってもらった。
en: I got the driver to wait.
alternatives: I had the driver wait.
I asked the driver to wait.
point: get + 人 + to do、have + 人 + 原形

ja: 車掌は推測を確かな案内と偽った。
en: The conductor palmed off conjecture as authoritative guidance.
alternatives: The conductor passed off guesses as reliable guidance.
The conductor passed off conjecture as authoritative guidance.
point: palm off は偽って渡す、conjecture は推測、authoritative は信頼できる。
